title: Adopt Greg's post-run debris rule in TermAl's standing commit rule (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, /review-changes)
outcome: TermAl's standing commit rule accepts a full gate whose only post-run difference is newly created untracked, non-ignored debris, recorded by the integration owner and excluded from the committed tree. The wording is identical to Engram's counterpart w-e68590888978, and it lands only after the instruction-change conditions (a), (b) and (c).
acceptance: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md carry, in identical hunks, the candidate-commits bullet and the concurred clarifications T1 (landing defined as committing on master or fast-forwarding master to a candidate commit, the three conditions holding for the exact commit being landed), T2 ('before every landing') and T3 (the relayed-word sentence naming the candidate-commits bullet), exactly as in the frozen final4 input concurred on this item.

.claude/commands/review-changes.md and .claude/commands/fix-bug.md carry the concurred candidate-commit paragraphs and authority clarifications exactly as in the frozen final4 input, without the removed integration-commit sentence and without any review-reuse rule.

CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .claude/commands/review-changes.md carry the concurred post-run debris gate clause (newly created untracked, non-ignored paths recorded by the integration owner as non-input debris and excluded from the committed tree), landing together with or after TermAl's launcher support for it.
Each landing step lands under the instruction-change conditions (a), (b) and (c), with a clean review pair on its exact input and a green full gate on the exact landed commit or tree.
